title: The hub's Google verifier checks a contribution's category against the primary type and its opening hours against the normalized weekly periods; email, social profiles and photo references stay unsupported
steps: S1: An account contributes category 'Cafe' and 'bar', and opening_hours as the same weekly periods in another order, as a subset, as one changed time, and as weekday text matching Google's lines up to case and punctuation and as text with another time, for a Google place whose primary type is cafe.
S2: The same account contributes a social_profile and a photo_ref naming Google as the source.
S3: fetchPlaceVerification reads a place with primaryType and regularOpeningHours.
expect: S1: one Google read; 'Cafe' accepted, 'bar' differs_from_source; reordered periods accepted, subset and changed time differs_from_source; matching text accepted, other text differs_from_source.
S2: both rejected as unsupported_source with no Google read.
S3: the mask asks for primaryType and regularOpeningHours; the answer carries category and openingHours with only day/hour/minute per period.
evidence: Before: category and opening_hours had no Google check, so every such observation was rejected as unsupported_source
fence: createGooglePlacesAdapter judges category by primary type and opening_hours by weeklyPeriods or word-normalized weekday text

tests: category is judged against the primary type
email, social profiles and photo references stay unsupported
the field list is closed and every field has a value check
fetchPlaceVerification asks for the facts the hub checks
